title: Gate-level Implementation and Resource Analysis of Lackadaisical Quantum Walk Search
summary: Lackadaisical quantum walks (LQW) extend discrete-time quantum walks (DTQW) by introducing weighted self-loops, enabling improved spatial-search performance through controlled localization of the walker. Despite substantial theoretical progress, practical gate-level implementations suitable for quantum hardware remain largely unexplored, limiting evaluation under realistic architectural constraints, noise, and resource requirements.
